# Mode {#sec-mode}

## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}
One mode for chameau, deux mode for dromadaire.

Le mode sa la mode!

This is trivial if start from the distribution, it is just the one with the highest frequency.
Isn't that why they called it mode? And to a certain extent.

This naturally apply to qualitative or quantitative variables.

But, be aware that it does not need to be unique.
